frontier: Client screens not yet inspected: lobby, locker, pass, match HUD, results on each platform

items.label: Lobby: play button, mode select (solo/duo/squads), room code create/join, player name, navigation to locker and pass
Locker: browse and equip original cosmetics (outfits, pickaxes, gliders, banners); locked items show unlock level
Progression: XP bar, level, battle-pass-style unlock track with claimed/locked cosmetics and career stats
Match screen: bus phase, drop, gameplay HUD, build mode, spectating and reconnect overlay
Results: victory banner or placement, eliminations, damage, XP gained, per-squad summary, return to lobby
Rooms with join codes: create, join by code, ready state, host-only start, bots fill to 16
Battle bus along a seeded line; jump action; forced drop at path end; glide to landing
Shrinking storm ring with phased wait/shrink timers and escalating damage; storm timer and next-circle on minimap
100 HP + 100 shield; small/big shield, bandage, medkit with documented caps and use times
Floor loot and chests with rarity tiers (common..legendary), ammo types, materials; pickup/swap/drop
Harvest wood/stone/metal from seeded nodes with the pickaxe up to 500 each
Build walls/floors/ramps/roofs from selected material, placement preview, structures grow to full HP, edit door/window
Server-authoritative hitscan weapons (Scrapper, Hornet, Ridgeline, Boomstick, Longshot) with reload, spread, damage falloff
Solo/duo/squad modes; friendly fire off; teammates listed on HUD; team-aware win condition
Deterministic seeded bots harvest, loot, fight, build and avoid the storm
HUD: health/shield bars, hotbar, materials, minimap + compass, storm timer, elimination feed, players-left, squad panel
After elimination spectate a living teammate or the eliminator; cycle targets
XP awarded per match (survival, elims, placement) persisted locally; levels unlock cosmetics
Keyboard+mouse on web/macOS, touch joysticks and buttons on iOS/Android, trackpad on macOS
Client reconnects with its token and resumes the same player within the grace window; overlay shown meanwhile
Client-side movement prediction reconciled against server snapshots; interest-managed replication
Dark and light themes with a shared design system (type scale, color tokens, spacing, motion)
Web, iOS, Android and macOS clients join one room as a squad, play a full deterministic match and receive identical summaries
A single human creates a room, starts a solo match filled with bots and reaches the results screen
An eliminated player spectates until the match ends and sees the results screen
Lobby renders identically across the four clients at the shared reference size (web baseline)
Gameplay HUD renders identically across the four clients at the shared reference size (web baseline)
Results screen renders identically across the four clients at the shared reference size (web baseline)
All art, icons, cosmetics names and audio are original Lastfort creations (no proprietary Fortnite assets)
JSON-over-WebSocket protocol between clients and the Dart server, documented in PROTOCOL.md
